# Kubernetes job pods OOMKilled with exit 137 during batch run

A nightly batch Job fails partway; the pod restarts and fails again.

The batch loaded the entire input file into memory instead of streaming it; larger nightly inputs exceeded the 512Mi container limit and were OOMKilled (exit 137) — same exit code as the eviction incident but a different cause.

1. Confirm OOMKilled exit 137 and correlate with input size
2. Refactor the batch to stream/process the input in chunks
3. Right-size the container memory limit for the workload
4. Re-run the nightly Job and confirm it completes

Error Details
```
State: Terminated Reason: OOMKilled exit code 137; container memory limit 512Mi exceeded; last log line mid-batch before kill
```

Tags: infra, kubernetes, oomkilled, exit-137, batch
